'''2006 Tennessee DPC''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Tennessee (10 June 2006). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Tennessee
* '''Dates:''' 10 June 2006
